name: Address for Rep. of Moldova
description: Adds a district administrative-area level and predefined districts/localities for the Republic of Moldova to the Address module, loaded from bundled JSON.
project_description:
This module extends the module address by adding the list of districts and subdivisions for the Rep. of Moldova.

 Read the documentation for more information.

 Dependencies 
 
 address 
 
 Composer 
 If your site is managed via Composer , use Composer to download the module, which will also download the required library:

 composer require "drupal/address_md ~1.0"
